message: More settings now sync between your devices: focus session breaks, 24-hour time, hidden help text, how Projects and Recipes are sorted and grouped, the kitchen's restock and running-low options, your journal prompts, the weight unit, the food log's pinned nutrients, and your subway lines. A weight goal, protein per body weight and exercise boosts sync only to your own sync server when health logs are on there, never to iCloud.
